title: Two-conveyor sequenced start (anti-pileup)
nl_spec: Two conveyors feed one another: C1 (upstream) drops material onto C2 (downstream). To avoid material pile-up, the downstream conveyor C2 must always be running before the upstream conveyor C1. Implement as a state machine: 0 = Off, 1 = Starting (C2 running, C1 still stopped), 2 = Running (both). On StartPB enter Starting; after PT_SEQ = 2 ticks move to Running. StopPB or an activated emergency stop (EStop normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) stops both immediately. SAFETY-CRITICAL: C1 must never run unless C2 is running. Use an internal INT State (0..2) and a TON timer. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named conveyor_seq with inputs StartPB, StopPB, EStop and outputs C1, C2.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: The upstream conveyor never runs unless the downstream conveyor is running.
On emergency stop, both conveyors are stopped.
Whenever stop is pressed, both conveyors are stopped.

scenarios.description: Downstream starts first, upstream after the delay

notes: Sequenced start enforces downstream-before-upstream ordering; the ordering invariant G(C1 -> C2) is the safety-critical property.
